projects.title: Ethereum Blockchain Fraud Wallet Detection
projects.description: Hybrid fraud detection model combining Random Forest, Isolation Forest, and rule-based risk scoring. Engineered wallet-level transaction graphs, features, and statistical profiling to build a leakage-free prediction pipeline.

projects.title: Noise-Aware Adaptive n-Qubit Teleportation
projects.description: Developing reinforcement learning algorithms for dynamic circuit adaptation in noisy quantum computing environments. Implements post-selection error mitigation to preserve high-fidelity state transmission across unreliable channels.

projects.title: Crop Sage: ML-Based Crop Prediction
projects.description: Supervised learning engine predicting ideal agricultural crops based on regional soil chemistry, humidity, rainfall, and thermal variations. Built and trained during the IEDC Lab at UEM Kolkata.

projects.title: SWaT Digital Twin & Industrial Anomaly Detection
projects.description: Analyzed SWaT operational telemetry across water-purification testbeds. Deployed process-aware anomaly detection to guarantee within-event anomaly detection for critical physical plant safeguards.
